lesson: State positivity is invariant under conjugation by any invertible element, so twins of the form b xi (T-NR, finite DEL) can be rejected only by an exact relation, never by positivity. The overlap of two product-vector states is either the convergent Euler product or 0: for beta <= 1 the states are orthogonal, so no function of tau remains that could read a zero.
